name: get_session_command
description:
Retrieves the current status and details of a command executed in a session. Use the `wait` parameter to block until the command finishes execution.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v2/sandboxes/sessions/{sessionId}/cmd/{cmdId} --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

cmdId.description: The unique identifier of the command to retrieve.

sessionId.description: The unique identifier of the session containing the command.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.

wait.description: If set to "true", the request will block until the command finishes execution. Useful for synchronously waiting for command completion.
